'''''The Essential Legends Collection''''' is a series of novels published first by [[Del Rey]], then by [[Random House Worlds]] from [[2023]] onwards. The series reprints select books from the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in celebration of the 50th anniversary of [[Lucasfilm]]. The first selection of books was published on [[June 15]], [[2021]]. The books in this collection were originally printed in trade paperback format - in 2024, hardback special editions started to be produced by [[Inkstone Books]], in conjunction with Del Rey.
